column1: # Squirrel label bank, version 2 (LABELS_VERSION in src/clip/labels.rs).
# slug<TAB>English class names separated by |[<TAB>minimum cosine]. Every name
# goes through every prompt template (src/clip/templates.rs); the label's
# embedding is their average. One label per concept: near-synonyms are names
# of one label, not labels competing with each other. The optional third
# column overrides the model's default cosine threshold for that label only.
# "background" is reserved (the generic prompts every label must beat).
# Changing anything here means a new file and a new LABELS_VERSION.

column2: night|night sky|starry sky|city lights at night|neon lights
